name: buffarr
description: buffarr runs two self-hosted media-automation tools in a single container: prefetch watches what's playing on Jellyfin, Emby, Plex, or Tautulli and tells Sonarr to grab the next episodes of a show before you catch up to them, so you never hit a gap mid-binge; unmonitor protects Sonarr/Radarr from grabbing fake or low-quality pre-release files by unmonitoring content until its actual air/release date (plus a configurable delay) has passed, then automatically re-monitoring it so normal grabbing resumes.

paths.name: Path: /config
paths.description: conf/config.toml (optional, see config.example.toml) and logs/ (rotating buffarr.log) live here.

ports.name: Port: Webhook / health
ports.description: Webhook trigger (/trigger/sonarr, /trigger/radarr) and health-check (/health) HTTP server.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Timezone for date calculations, e.g. Europe/London.

variables.name: DRY_RUN
variables.description: unmonitor: 1 = log actions only, 0 = apply them. Start at 1 to check the logs before going live.

variables.name: ENABLE_SONARR
variables.description: unmonitor: manage Sonarr episode monitoring (1=yes, 0=no).

variables.name: SONARR_URL
variables.description: Sonarr base URL, e.g. http://10.0.0.2:8989 -- shared by unmonitor and prefetch.

variables.name: SONARR_API_KEY
variables.description: Sonarr API key (Settings -> General -> Security).

variables.name: ENABLE_RADARR
variables.description: unmonitor: manage Radarr movie monitoring (1=yes, 0=no).

variables.name: RADARR_URL
variables.description: Radarr base URL, e.g. http://10.0.0.2:7878.

variables.name: RADARR_API_KEY
variables.description: Radarr API key (Settings -> General -> Security).

variables.name: ENABLE_PREFETCH
variables.description: Enable the prefetch feature (predictive episode fetching from a media server). Requires SONARR_URL/SONARR_API_KEY and the MEDIA_SERVER_* fields below.

variables.name: MEDIA_SERVER_TYPE
variables.description: jellyfin, emby, plex, or tautulli.

variables.name: MEDIA_SERVER_URL
variables.description: Media server base URL, e.g. http://10.0.0.2:8096.

variables.name: MEDIA_SERVER_API_KEY
variables.description: Jellyfin/Emby/Tautulli API key, or Plex server token.

variables.name: SLEEP_MINUTES
variables.description: unmonitor: minutes between scheduled passes.

variables.name: DELAY_MINUTES
variables.description: unmonitor: minutes after air/release before re-monitoring (can be negative).

variables.name: SKIP_IF_FILE
variables.description: unmonitor: skip items that already have a file (1=yes, 0=no).

variables.name: AUTO_TAG_NAME
variables.description: unmonitor: tag applied to items buffarr unmonitored.

variables.name: IGNORE_TAG_NAME
variables.description: unmonitor: tag that excludes an item from management entirely.

variables.name: PREFERRED_RELEASE
variables.description: unmonitor/Radarr: either, digital, or physical.

variables.name: IGNORE_INCINEMAS
variables.description: unmonitor/Radarr: ignore cinema release dates (1=yes, 0=no).

variables.name: RADARR_REMONITOR_WINDOW_DAYS
variables.description: unmonitor/Radarr: only re-monitor movies released within N days (0=unlimited).

variables.name: SONARR_REMONITOR_WINDOW_DAYS
variables.description: unmonitor/Sonarr: only re-monitor episodes aired within N days (0=unlimited).

variables.name: SEASON_PACK_MODE
variables.description: unmonitor/Sonarr: re-monitor whole seasons at once instead of episode-by-episode (1=yes, 0=no).

variables.name: SEASON_PACK_MODE_TAG
variables.description: unmonitor/Sonarr: tag marking series that use season-pack mode.

variables.name: MEDIA_SERVER_USERS
variables.description: prefetch: comma-separated user IDs/names to watch (default: all).

variables.name: MEDIA_SERVER_LIBRARIES
variables.description: prefetch: comma-separated library names to watch (default: all), e.g. TV Shows.

variables.name: PREFETCH_INTERVAL
variables.description: prefetch: polling interval in seconds.

variables.name: PREFETCH_NUM
variables.description: prefetch: episodes to keep available in advance.

variables.name: PREFETCH_REQUEST_SEASONS
variables.description: prefetch: prefer season-pack searches over per-episode (1=yes, 0=no).

variables.name: PREFETCH_APPEND_TO_QUEUE
variables.description: prefetch: append newly-available episodes to the player's queue -- Jellyfin/Emby/Plex only, experimental (1=yes, 0=no).

variables.name: PREFETCH_CHECK_AIRED
variables.description: prefetch: skip episodes that haven't aired yet (1=yes, 0=no).

variables.name: PREFETCH_CONNECTION_RETRIES
variables.description: prefetch: retries when initially connecting to Sonarr/media server.

variables.name: PREFETCH_EXCLUDE_TAG
variables.description: prefetch: Sonarr tag that excludes a series from prefetching.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR.
